To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
maternal time investment is a key factor in the cognitive development of young children.

(1) maternal time investment in children is an important factor for children’s cognitive outcomes and (2) the effect of time investment on child cognitive outcomes is heterogeneous with respect to the mother’s education and family structure.

maternal time investment is an important determinant of children’s cognitive development, and the effect is larger than estimated in previous studies that use maternal employment status as an indicator of maternal time investment.

the causal effects of time investment on child cognitive development.
the effects of maternal time investment on children’s cognitive outcomes.
the effects of the amount of time parents spend with their children.
